name: Testing - Pet Punch Simulator
desc: Welcome to the testing version of Pet Punch Simulator! This game is exclusively available to testers and roles above, who have the opportunity to test out new updates before they are released to the public. As a tester, you’ll be able to experience new features, provide feedback, and help shape the future of the game. Join us on this exciting adventure and become a part of the development process for Pet Punch Simulator!
